objective: Prove a depth- and rarity-independent retained-U payment on an expanding restriction-closed class, including adaptive physical-credit ownership and arbitrary retained terminal cores.
prior_status: A retained-difference telescope existed for arbitrary fresh-selector trees, but its raw packet was unpaid; quadratic one-coordinate payment was proved separately in B01.
mathematical_delta: Combined exact quadratic local payment with a new adaptive physical-cylinder ownership lemma, yielding a complete constant-3 tree payment. Extended the class to arbitrary overlapping quadratic controls, adaptive pruning, branchwise coordinate reuse, and arbitrary disjoint Boolean terminal cores retained exactly.
previous_bound: No complete depth-independent A023 payment for this adaptive class.
new_bound: U(F)-sum_l w_l U(F_l) <= 3 I_T <= 3 I(q) for F=qg with q quadratic and g arbitrary on a disjoint block.

constant_ledger.bias_dependence: none for the arbitrary retained disjoint core; activation reach is dyadic

verification.method: integer Walsh arithmetic and exact rational tree accounting
verification.scope: diagnostic through control dimension four; theorem proof is analytic

remaining_obstacle: No approximate affine-coset merge payment is proved when a queried quadratic control is coupled to an arbitrary nonflat shared core; changing coherent cores across a hierarchy remain uncontrolled.
next_action: Freeze a one-node shared-core coset-stability inequality with aI+bU, b<1; derive its exact asymmetry term and test it on a quadratic control coupled to a one-point-defect core.
